TS031 comment-form

A comment is written as prose: it opens with a capital letter and closes with a full stop.

languages: go javascript odin python rust typescript zig
severity: info
default: opt-in
group: stable

TigerStyle: "Comments are sentences, with a space after the slash, with a capital letter and a full stop, or a colon if they relate to something that follows. Comments are well-written prose describing the code, not just scribblings in the margin. Comments after the end of a line _can_ be phrases, with no punctuation."
